subject: SI Field Readiness Syllabus and Mentorship Plan
messages:
From: Maya Rao <maya@brightpath.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner onboarding — field enablement and mentorship

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Brightpath team is excited to move toward a formal engagement. Before we get to contractual steps, our consulting leads asked for an operational syllabus that we can use to train delivery consultants and field engineers. Specifically they're looking for:

- A 6–8 week enablement syllabus with week-by-week learning objectives
- A mentor assignment matrix (who at Redwood owns what subject area)
- A short "quick start" for consultants to run their first integration POC in one week

Do you have a template or recommendation for how Redwood typically runs SI onboarding? If you can share a baseline syllabus and any suggested timelines (and who from your side would mentor key topics), that would be perfect.

Best,
Maya
Maya Rao
Partner Programs, Brightpath Consulting

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner onboarding — field enablement and mentorship

Hi Maya — great to hear from you and glad the demo resonated.

We do have a repeatable field-readiness framework we run with consultancies; Im attaching a first-draft syllabus and a lightweight mentor matrix for your review. High level approach: 6 weeks total (3 weeks core technical, 2 weeks applied workshops/POC, 1 week handoff & ops). We can compress to a 3-week bootcamp if your team needs faster time-to-value.

Next steps I propose:
1) Review the attached syllabus (SI_Field_Readiness_Syllabus_v1.pdf).
2) Marissa will scope the mentor matrix/subject leads and confirm availability.
3) We set a 30-minute alignment call next week to lock dates and calendar invites.

Marissa: can you take the lead on mapping mentors and estimate hours per topic?

Thanks — attaching syllabus and a quick playbook.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Partner Enablement | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
